description: Feature 3.8 slide claim audit — unsupported claims check

unsupported_accuracy_claim.description: Claiming model can accurately/predictively determine hit success

causal_shap_claim.description: Claiming SHAP proves causation, not just model behavior
examples_of_correct_language: SHAP describes model behavior, not causal relationships
SHAP tells us which features drove the prediction
Within this training data, songs with higher X tended to have higher predicted popularity
A positive SHAP value does not prove that changing X increases real-world popularity
Delta describes change in model output, not real-world effect
What-If answers: what would the model predict if...?
A positive delta does not prove that changing X increases real-world popularity

global_dataset_claim.description: Claiming dataset represents all music globally
examples_of_correct_language: Available dataset — not all music globally

unsupported_performance_claim.description: Claims SLAs or guaranteed performance outside benchmark scope

live_inference_in_offline_claim.description: Claiming offline mode does live inference

auditor_note: All slides use accurate, evidence-based language. No causal claims for SHAP/What-If. Dataset scope correctly labeled. Project correctly labeled as academic prototype.
